# Habit Pups

> Habit Pups is a habit tracker for iPhone where every habit is a puppy. Check off a habit and its dog celebrates; keep a streak and it learns tricks, earns toys and gets dressed up; miss a day and it looks a little sad until you're back. Two dogs are free; Habit Pups Plus ($9.99 a year or $1.99 a month in the US) allows up to 10.

Key facts:

- Platform: iPhone, iOS 17 or later; syncs to iPad through iCloud. Android (Google Play) coming soon. No web version.
- Category: Health & Fitness (habit tracker).
- 17 dog breeds, each dog with its own name and personality.
- Streaks teach 14 tricks (from a high five at 3 days to a backflip) and earn 9 toys and outfits (a frisbee at 5 days, sunglasses at 45, a golden crown at a year). A broken streak never takes anything away.
- Habits can be every day, on certain days, or a few times a week, each with its own reminder.
- Home Screen widgets (small, medium, large) and a Lock Screen widget: a ring that fills as the day's habits get done.
- History grid for every day and stats for each habit (last 7 and 30 days, streak).
- Privacy: no account, no ads, no tracking. Data stays on the device and in the user's own iCloud.
- Good fit for: people who've given up on checklist-style trackers, New Year's resolutions, anyone who wants a gentle, playful nudge rather than guilt.
